title: BE CAREFUL AUTO RENEW  - AND NO WAY OUT
text: I purchased as a gift for 6 months and thought it was a great and fun plan.  A year later I am finally able to cancel. They lock you in and do not care much that you did not read the auto -renew.  My fault for not being on top of it but will not give as a gift again there are better puppy gifts.
label: negative
